codes.name: AL
codes.description: Always. All MFA segments (whether denoting errors or not) must be returned via the application-level acknowledgment message

codes.name: ER
codes.description: Error/Reject conditions only.  Only MFA segments denoting errors must be returned via the application-level acknowledgment for this message

codes.name: SU
codes.description: Success.  Only MFA segments denoting success must be returned via the application-level acknowledgment for this message
